summary:
TERMINAL ADJUDICATION — NARROW — Adjudicator 3. Original task browser-launcher-project-route-binding-correction-20261123, pinned spec f05690d43b43cc775ce9c778447d4cdb5364b111, Stage B exact source lease; immutable review 6d1406275efb4aae9de35db27f66f61c (ChangesRequested 12872, Reviewer 4; source owner Worker 19); finding findings/stale-turn-across-route-transition.md blob 53c0cf6ab6f834d7a8e6df4e1694ab1c92372872; summary abaa3fd07848bf00f7d020234395ee34ad147944; frozen 90acadead16c8e0708ad4da323bccca538e2c907, base d63c49dacda93e246c3b38fe3854ea7a0b2f2135. Independent of source, reviewer and corrective implementation; prior adjudication 12673 was a bounded policy decision, not this implementation or review. This is a distinct new finding on the new frozen source; no recursion or replacement of prior decision.

VALIDITY: reproduced independently using exact frozen launcher and unchanged test harness in memory. Matching bubble t+75, unrelated scoped durable B t+300, different bubble t+375 -> submitted B at first matching route poll, one synthetic Send, zero navigation. Frozen launchAgent.js:716–746 treats counts/text as new relative to pre-Send baseline and reads current route and DOM together but has no route-to-turn association. Existing atomic mismatch test at 1510–1519 passes because the DOM changes simultaneously; staggered transition fails. The claimed source behavior is real in the fixture. Neither live provider occurrence nor an unrelated route transition under ordinary operator conditions has been established.

SCOPE: existing Stage B spec explicitly requires genuine same-tab exact scoped durable route plus matching new turn or evidenced continuity, unknown at deadline if unbound; docs/ChatGPTAgentLauncher.md §5.5 explicitly requires matching newly rendered turn ON that route. Prior 12673 Narrow and W27 checkpoint12736 reject unbound identity, not project support. This is a bounded correction to the evidence rule, NOT a new adversarial-browser model, universal race-freedom, provider-authenticated identity, or proof against hypothetical identical unrelated prompts. Treat provider's UI as ordinarily trusted, not a guarantee that SPA route and DOM hydrate atomically.

IMPACT: on a newly created pinned background tab, one Send; if the UI changes to another same-project route while the original optimistic/landing turn is still rendered, it can persist wrong URL and classify as submitted, then close the agent-created evidence tab (BrowserBridge.fs:1015–1027 with closeAfterExecution=true). The bridge origin gate serializes its own launches but is not evidence of UI hydration or route identity. Prerequisite unrelated same-tab route transition and stale DOM; frequency unknown, no live incident or backend truth claimed. Wrong association has practical reconciliation/recovery consequences; no claim that backend work stopped or that unrelated user-created tabs close.

PRACTICALITY / ALTERNATIVES: separate acknowledgement from durable route association. Do not carry an already-observed matching turn from landing/temp/other route into a changed route as sufficient identity. A route epoch plus newly rendered matching turn on that route (not merely a new wrapper/node reference for retained text), or existing empirically grounded route-associated surface/turn continuity, is the bounded evidence criterion under the ordinary UI trust model. Reuse current polling/deadline, matching/sanitization and typed acknowledged route-unknown with null URL, no conversationRoute claim, retained pinned tab when close flag true. Route-first followed by a genuinely new matching rendered turn on unchanged scoped route remains an ordinary positive; route/DOM simultaneous first observation or delayed-route positives must have actual route-surface association or grounded continuity, not merely the two values in one sample. In particular frozen delayed A fixture 1477–1485 (match before URL, no new turn event) and staggered B negative have indistinguishable prefixes at t+300 apart from opaque UUID; do not preserve that fixture's unconditional submitted expectation by treating a later sample, node persistence, static document.readyState, text equality, or fixed grace interval as causal proof. Add a positive delayed-route scenario with grounded continuity or fresh matching turn on that route; if no existing signal is evidenced for the earlier bubble, preserve acknowledgement as unknown rather than fabricate success. Do not invent provider selector/guarantee, arbitrary waiting proof, guessed navigation, network interception/new protocol, or live sends. Residual inability to establish route may increase retained-tab/unknown frequency, unmeasured; report this availability/capacity tradeoff explicitly to Lead/Operator, not quietly weaken proof or broaden generic cleanup. If preserving an ambiguous no-navigation/delayed-route success is essential, that is an Operator policy decision/separately evidenced objective, not authorized by this finding.

FINAL DISPOSITION NARROW: accept existing causal-route evidence defect and only corrective Work needed to prevent an observed earlier matching turn from binding a later unrelated route without route-local fresh evidence or evidenced continuity. Corrective Work may be issued by Lead to authorized original owner on exact isolated Stage B source lease, preserving accepted model/attribution lineages, one Send, no replay/navigation, existing shared deadline, exact scope/origin/UUID and query/hash sanitization, ordinary home/legacy behavior, project entry/selectionOnly, typed ack/null URL retention and successful/generic cleanup. Regression: staggered mismatch both marker variants where applicable -> acknowledged route unknown null URL/one Send/no navigation; atomic mismatch/never-route/invalid scope/sidebar negatives remain unknown; route-first fresh matching positive and genuine continuity positives where evidenced; preserve no-ack generic unknown and flag true/false retention semantics. Include positive and negative ordering rather than test a single timing value. No mandatory new provider capability, no broad work on home route behavior, no requirement for absolute proof of all possible future UI races. If no existing route-associated evidence for ambiguous path, conservative existing unknown is sufficient within approved scope. Source-only freeze, independent reviewer, integration separate. Do not modify review verdict or source; no release authorization.
nextAction: Lead: consume this single terminal Narrow disposition for original W19 Stage B. Issue only a scoped corrective lease on exact frozen source, with the existing approved retention contract and ordered negative/positive fixtures; explicitly identify possible availability/retained-tab tradeoff. Require fresh independent review of corrected source, not review of adjudication. Preserve original ChangesRequested and separate acceptance/integration/release. Adjudication complete; no further adjudicator implementation or review work.
